label: Routers & networking
note: Marketing numbers like 'AC1200' or 'AX3000' are the sum of theoretical band speeds and tell a buyer almost nothing. The facts that decide whether a router is right — Wi-Fi generation, bands, port speed, mesh support — are all published and all ignored.

speed_class.label: Marketing speed class
speed_class.note: AC1200, AX3000 and so on. Recorded because listings use it, labelled as marketing because it is the sum of theoretical band maxima and not achievable on one device.

lan_speed_mbps.label: LAN port speed
lan_speed_mbps.note: A Wi-Fi 6 router with 100 Mbps ports cannot deliver a 300 Mbps connection over cable. This is the most common mismatch in the category.

coverage_sqft.label: Claimed coverage
coverage_sqft.note: A manufacturer claim, not a measurement. Recorded as stated.
